$schema: Arena's cube variants, in board-dropdown order. Loaded by bot/sets.py (Python) and frontend/src/data/cubeVariants.ts (JS). Edit here, both sides pick it up. 'expansion' is 17lands' name for the variant, kept verbatim on every draft event so the boards stay separable; the board code is CUBE-<slug>; 'glyph' is a 'keyrune:<glyph>' or 'mana:<glyph>' icon spec, the same form bot/scripts/upload_app_emojis.py takes; 'seasoned' bins the variant's drafts into per-set season boards instead of one flat board; 'soup' false drops the Soup colour chip on that cube's board, for a cube multicolour enough that Soup swallows most of it.
